page0.text:
I can't abandon Rider.
I ignore the pain in my left arm and my eroding memories,
draw the Azoth Blade, and dash at the black swordsman.

page1.text:
My decision and movement are swift.
My feet hurl me forward like a bomb blast,
and my body flies through the air like a bullet.

page2.text: My blood flows backward. My senses flow backward. Poison flows backward.

page3.text:
My left arm and my body are one.
The novice Shirou Emiya transforms into a superman.

page4.text:
...
One second feels like ten.
I can take her.
Right now, I can fight against Saber, if I pay the broken Shirou Emiya as a price!

page5.text:
"Run, Rider...!"
I slash from the side at the two clashing, dark figures.
"Ngh... Shirou!?"
Rider kneels on the ground.
"........."
Saber reacts to me only with her eyes.

page6.text:
I got her.
I bring the Azoth Blade down on Saber's defenseless left arm.

page7.text:
"...Wha—"
It shatters.
The dagger should have pierced her body, but it completely shattered as soon as it touched her.
A lightspeed attack slashes me in response.
I'm sliced open.
Just as I intended, an arm goes tumbling to the ground.

page8.text:
"..."
Rider jumps back, while Saber stands calmly.
"Ah... Aaargh, gah......!"
I kneel, trying desperately to stop the blood fountaining from my left shoulder.

page9.text:
"Hah, ugh, guh, aaaaahhhhh!"
I writhe in agony.
"I did not fail to react. I simply did not need to, Shirou,"
The black swordsman declares, in a stone-cold voice.
I hear footsteps approaching.
I'm helpless. She's be...behind me.

page10.text:
"I've plucked out your fangs. ...Sakura does not say it, but she wants you to live. She would prefer that I render you harmless and bring you to her.
But..."

page11.text:
A sword bites into my back.
The cold weight of death pushes in only a few centimeters, stopping just short of my heart.

page12.text:
"...Choose. You can die here to my sword, or I can deliver you to Sakura, where you'll meet a fate worse than death. The choice is yours, Shirou."
...My consciousness fades.
I feel my blood leaving my body, and the weight of the blade in my back.

page13.text:
...
...I don't know which option I chose.
All I know is one thing:
There's nothing I can do to save Sakura anymore.
